csv_project_name: Plan for Airport Transit Connection IQC
csv_scope_of_work: The San Diego Association of Governments may be seeking a consultant to provide Plan services for "The 2025 Regional Plan proposes to implement Rapid bus services Rapid 992 and Rapid 994 - between the San Diego International Airport and the existing transit hubs of Santa Fe Depot and Old Town Transit Center as a nearer-term step towards the greater Airport Transit Connection (ATC) vision. The enhanced services will build upon two existing bus services to the airport - MTS local bus route 992 and San Diego Flyer shuttle. The improvements will enhance the speed, reliability, and comfort for airport passengers and employees connecting to San Diego s transit hubs through the implementation of transit priority infrastructure and supporting technology. This project aims to accomplish the following: -Complete a route enhancement analysis for two proposed Rapid bus connections between the airport and two transit hubs Santa Fe Depot and Old Town Transit Center -Identify the infrastructure required to prioritize bus operations over general-purpose traffic while ensuring improved speed, reliability, and comfort for transit riders -Identify ways to optimize the Rapid corridors to ensure planned improvements will seamlessly integrate with other modes, and that benefits can be shared by other services on the corridor, including privately operated shuttles and other MTS bus routes. -Increase eligibility and competitiveness for future grant opportunities, such as the Federal Transit Agency (FTA) Capital Investment Grants (CIG) program for New Starts, Small Starts, and/or Core Capacity -Identify strategies for increasing ATC bus ridership as a precursor to a rail investment -Determine environmental clearance strategy including CEQA Initial Study, NEPA Categorical Exclusion checklist or similar "
csv_disciplines_requested: Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Planning/Master Planning, Public Transit Planning, Transportation Planning
csv_comments: '* * * ADVANCE NOTICE * * *- The RFQ/RFP package is expected to be available prior to 10/01/2026- Contract value: $1.5M
title: Plan for Airport Transit Connection IQC
short_description: Planning study for rapid bus connections between San Diego Airport and major transit hubs.
project_scope: Planning services for the Airport Transit Connection program in San Diego. The study covers two proposed Rapid bus corridors: Rapid 992 and Rapid 994 between San Diego International Airport and the transit hubs Santa Fe Depot and Old Town Transit Center. Scope includes route enhancement analysis, identification of transit-priority infrastructure and supporting technology, corridor optimization for integration with other transport modes, strategies to improve speed, reliability, comfort, and ridership, support for future grant competitiveness, and definition of an environmental clearance strategy including CEQA Initial Study and NEPA Categorical Exclusion checklist or similar.
services: Planning, master planning, public transit planning, transportation planning, and surveying/GIS/mapping.
relevance_explanation:
- Pure planning and transit corridor study without structural or bridge design scope.
- No building, bridge, roof, stadium, or special load-bearing structure indicated.
- Includes transport planning, GIS, and environmental clearance strategy, which are outside sbp's core focus.
- Early strategic value for structural engineering appears very limited.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated. The source only mentions a consultant contract value of 1500000 for planning services. Potential future infrastructure may include transit-priority measures and supporting technology, but no defined construction quantities, lengths, structures, or implementation budget are provided, so a realistic construction cost estimate is not possible.
fee_explanation: No sbp-relevant engineering fee is stated. The source mentions a consultant contract value of 1500000, but this appears to cover general planning services rather than structural engineering services.
references_qualifications: Disciplines requested: Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Planning/Master Planning, Public Transit Planning, Transportation Planning.
contracting_authority: San Diego Association of Governments, San Diego, California, USA. Agency ID: 341.
notes: Advance notice only. RFQ/RFP package expected before 2026-10-01. Target market: Transportation. County: San Diego. Project number: 842414-1. Project ID: 1009476. DR #: 202400143660. Although no bridge category truly fits, a fixed category is required; this project is actually a transit planning study rather than a bridge or building project.
